integrity: The proof separates the source's local-finiteness/amalgamation theorems and prior free-algebra cardinalities from the new Fraïssé-orbit identification. The finite replay independently reconstructs the two-generator algebra and its filter/congruence count.
scientific_limitations: The result transfers rather than solves the unknown four-generator enumeration problem. The proof is a short synthesis of standard universal algebra and Fraïssé theory, so an unindexed equivalent may exist.
title: Free-algebra sizes are the tuple-orbit profile of the generic Brouwerian semilattice
